// A guard on an entry or exit action guards the body each language selects, tagged or not
class Lamp
{

  //------------------------
  // MEMBER VARIABLES
  //------------------------

  //Lamp Attributes
  private $n;

  //Lamp State Machines
  private static $SmOff = 1;
  private static $SmOn = 2;
  private $sm;

  //------------------------
  // CONSTRUCTOR
  //------------------------

  public function __construct()
  {
    $this->n = 0;
    $this->setSm(self::$SmOff);
  }

  //------------------------
  // INTERFACE
  //------------------------

  public function setN($aN)
  {
    $wasSet = false;
    $this->n = $aN;
    $wasSet = true;
    return $wasSet;
  }

  public function getN()
  {
    return $this->n;
  }

  public function getSmFullName()
  {
    $answer = $this->getSm();
    return $answer;
  }

  public function getSm()
  {
    if ($this->sm == self::$SmOff) { return "SmOff"; }
    elseif ($this->sm == self::$SmOn) { return "SmOn"; }
    return null;
  }

  public function flip()
  {
    $wasEventProcessed = false;
    
    $aSm = $this->sm;
    if ($aSm == self::$SmOff)
    {
      $this->exitSm();
      $this->setSm(self::$SmOn);
      $wasEventProcessed = true;
    }
    elseif ($aSm == self::$SmOn)
    {
      $this->setSm(self::$SmOff);
      $wasEventProcessed = true;
    }
    return $wasEventProcessed;
  }

  private function exitSm()
  {
    if ($this->sm == self::$SmOff)
    {
      if (n < 9)
        {
          n = 4;
        }
    }
  }

  private function setSm($aSm)
  {
    $this->sm = $aSm;

    // entry actions and do activities
    if ($this->sm == self::$SmOff)
    {
      if (n > 1)
        {
          $this->n = 3;
        }
    }
  }

  public function equals($compareTo)
  {
    return $this == $compareTo;
  }

  public function delete()
  {}

}
